title: Writing songs from her own feelings
summary: She says every song she wrote came from her feelings and that she is only talking about herself.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well, when you wrote the songs, composed the songs that you did, is it because they expressed your feelings, whatever you were feeling?

Uh-huh, every song I wrote is from my feelings. That's why I say I write about something about -- I'm talking about myself when I write me a song. I'm talking about myself. Can't nobody get mad about what I say because I ain't talking about nobody but myself.
Well, I guess the people like the songs so much because they felt what you were feeling.
Because I was talking from my heart.

Because I was so jealous, I said a jealous woman like me always hears bad news, you know, because she always listens to everything that she ______.
